items.q: That's when I met Ben, Ben Webster... he says, 'Hey, man, the way you play a show, if you ever come to New York you won't have no worries...'

ctx.x: That's when I met Ben, Ben Webster, and he was with Cab, and he says, "Hey, man, the way you play a show, if you ever come to New York you won't have no worries, because they're always looking for somebody to play a show."
Of course it was wonderful experience for you.
